# Zero Reception — The Sign and the Practice That Receives It

## #0 — Receiving a mark is an operation

Zero's reception concerns what a receiving practice permits a sign to do. A familiar shape can enter a new script, table, calculation or account without carrying all its previous uses into the new setting. Conversely, a new notation can preserve an operation across a change in language and material. Reception therefore requires both recognition and reconstruction: which mark was received, through what carrier, under which rules, and with what consequence for those using it?

[A10](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) **grounds** this dossier's historical office. The first advent makes absence operative; [A36](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) receives its later symbolic return. The [mathematics companion](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md) develops the different laws and constructions, while the [zero–subject companion](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT.md) develops the authorial double history. This dossier supplies the intervening scrutiny of transmission and reception: a story about a sign must itself answer to its documentary sources, especially when that story has become philosophically convenient.

E1's [Name-through-Count](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#name-through-count) **grounds** the comparison at evidence register 3. A receiving count confers permissions; the word or mark alone does not confer them. E4's [Account does not replace source](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-does-not-replace-source) then requires the history of those permissions to remain recoverable. These operations do not establish lexical descent, which belongs to register 1, or historical chronology, which belongs to register 2. Poetic re-entry has register 4 and cannot settle either question by resonance.

## #1 — A numeral receives rules, and rules meet an exception

[Kaplan's selected OUP printing](../sources/mathematics-logic/kaplan/kaplan-1999-nothing-that-is/kaplan-1999-nothing-that-is.md) **historicises** the itinerary through Babylonian positional marking, Hellenistic astronomical notation, Indian arithmetic and later transmission. Its value here is the distinction among offices. An internal separator, an absent measure and an arithmetic element belong to different practices. They cannot be collapsed into a single dated invention merely because a modern reader calls all of them zero. The [Kaplan note](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/kaplan-nothing-that-is.md) deliberately preserves his stylistic and conceptual contribution while refusing to make it sole reception-history authority.

The Indian arithmetic witness is more local and exact. [Colebrooke](../sources/mathematics-logic/brahmagupta/colebrooke-1817-brahmagupta-bhaskara/colebrooke-1817-brahmagupta-bhaskara.md) **sources** Brahmagupta's rules in chapter XVIII, rules 31 and 34, printed p. 339. The sign has additive and multiplicative consequences; it is available for calculation rather than simply indicating an empty place. The [Brahmagupta reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/brahmagupta.md) thus has an independently housed selected English witness, with critical Sanskrit and broader chronology still distinct tasks.

Bhāskara's *Bīja-gaṇita* I.14 and I.16, printed pp. 137–138, take the denominator into another regime. The written expression is retained; the divine-immutability comparison accompanies its behaviour under addition or subtraction of finite quantities. The primary translation's mathematical rule and theological comparison have separate passage cards. Neither amounts to the general field identity `a/0 = ∞`. [Dutta's modern reconstruction](../sources/mathematics-logic/dutta/dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india/dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india.md) **qualifies** a reception that judges these expressions only by modern cancellation rules. To evaluate the proposal, one must state which operations are retained and which inferences are forbidden.

For example, `6·0 = 17·0` is true under ordinary arithmetic. Dividing away the common factor would destroy the very law that made the equality possible. A changed treatment of a denominator must therefore carry its restrictions with it. [C52](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **returns-to** this distinction between changing an algebra and performing an ordinary calculation inside it. [A15](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) receives the corresponding requirement for a declared criterion: a calculation remains exact through its units and laws, not by suppressing them.

The historical receiver can thus misunderstand through excessive familiarity. Reading an older expression as an unsuccessful modern one can lose the operation its users were attempting. Restoring that operation does not oblige accepting every old rule as valid under every newer system. It requires a source-specific comparison whose result names the actual disagreement.

## #2 — A reception story also requires a source

A decisive correction concerns [Nothaft's source house](../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/nothaft/nothaft-2020-satanic-ciphers/nothaft-2020-satanic-ciphers.md). The author's [Oxford repository abstract](https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid%3A71f4c8ca-2b6a-4393-94dc-8d81096985bc) describes his 2020 article as a critique of the familiar narrative connecting medieval zero, the Devil and institutional bans. The source house now records this critical purpose in its [abstract passage card](../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/nothaft/nothaft-2020-satanic-ciphers/nothaft-2020-satanic-ciphers.md#nothaft-2020-satanic-ciphers-q001); its former description as evidence of demonisation has been corrected. Its subtitle, *On the Genesis of a Modern Myth*, is load-bearing. The accepted manuscript could not be retrieved in this investigation; no detailed case or medieval passage is certified from the abstract.

The [Nothaft reference note](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/nothaft-satanic-ciphers.md) therefore survives as a corrective source obligation. The reception of a mathematical sign and the modern reception of a story about that sign are different histories. An attractive narrative can itself become a protected account when repeated authority replaces its documentary basis.

That correction changes the dossier's operation. It removes no mathematical achievement from India, Arabic transmission or Latin adoption. It removes an unsupported explanatory shortcut for the receiving culture. If a particular restriction is eventually established, the account must specify its jurisdiction, medium, purpose and period; a rule for one form of written accounting cannot silently stand for a prohibition on mathematical understanding. Equally, absence of such a rule does not demonstrate universal acceptance. [C03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C03-Determination.md) **returns-to** determination at this evidential boundary: a historical assertion must remain definite enough to test, rather than widening whenever a local witness fails.

E4's [Symbol answers to source](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source) is performed here through a correction to the account's own source-use. The source's title is not a token that can be recruited by resemblance to an existing thesis. What its author actually argues must be able to change the receiving interpretation. The essay's account of hidden authority becomes stronger when this particular authority-error can be corrected in its own apparatus.

## #3 — Gerbert and Salem require different recoveries

The [Gerbert reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/gerbert-sylvester-ii.md) asks about Latin reception of Hindu-Arabic numerals and explicitly retains chronology as unfinished work. Its proper development must distinguish acquaintance with numeral forms, their use in a calculating apparatus, and positional use of an operational zero. Those are different predicates. A biography naming mathematical learning does not by itself establish every one of them, and later reputation does not supply a contemporary technical witness.

The exact next source task is therefore a work-and-passage identification: establish the relevant Gerbert-era text or material account, its attribution and date, and the operation actually described. A primary source house is still missing for that task. This dossier does not fill the gap with a general claim that Gerbert introduced zero to Europe. The route remains live because the receiving medium is part of the operation: signs handled in one apparatus need not have the same permissions in written positional arithmetic.

The [Salem codex reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/salem-codex.md) has a different recovery. A concrete edition lead now exists: Moritz Cantor, *Ueber einen Codex des Klosters Salem*, *Zeitschrift für Mathematik und Physik* 10 (1865), 1–16, with an [institutional Heidelberg PDF address](https://archiv.ub.uni-heidelberg.de/volltextserver/12869/1/cantor_salem.pdf). The address returned an access challenge rather than the PDF during this investigation. The edition pointer is recovered; its Latin text, manuscript shelfmark, folio and dating are not yet independently verified here. No remembered short Latin line is substituted for that work.

An edition and its manuscript also retain different authority. The editor can supply a transcription, punctuation, conjecture and historical dating argument; the manuscript bears the inscription being edited. A later translation introduces another operation. Keeping those layers visible gives E1's [Count-to-Account](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-to-account) a concrete historical return: the report identifies what its evidence permits another reader to check. A precise locator is real progress without becoming a fictitious completed collation.

Gerbert and Salem consequently remain two source tasks. Their shared place in a story of Latin numerical reception does not make one evidence for the other. The dossier preserves the routes by which each can become more definite, while the already verified arithmetic witnesses continue to bear their own claims.

## #4 — Rotman's meta-subject is a distinct interlocutor

[Rotman's Signifying Nothing](../sources/mathematics-logic/rotman/rotman-1987-signifying-nothing/rotman-1987-signifying-nothing.md) **compares** zero's semiotic office with a problem this essay also encounters: an inscription can reorganise the field within which signs are produced and interpreted. The source house identifies the account of a meta-subject and the conjunction of numeral, vanishing point and imaginary money as the relevant inquiry. Chapter 2, pp. 27–56 in the 1987 edition, is the exact passage task. The house remains locator-needed, so this dossier neither fabricates a close reading of those pages nor quotes a sentence from them.

The [Rotman reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/rotman-semiotics-of-zero.md) preserves a disagreement essential to the comparison. Rotman's semiotic production of a meta-subject and the essay's irreducible subject-pole have different ontological commitments. A system can institute a role from which its signs are manipulated or described. That achievement does not, without another argument, explain the capacity through which the role and its institution become available to observation.

[A11](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **grounds** the native distinction: One is the uncounted Self-Identity, All the entire manifest field and each indefinite particular through which it appears. Their reciprocal dependence concerns being and manifestation in distinct respects; it is not a chronological story of zero existing first and manufacturing one later. [C49](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **returns-to** that aspectual distinction. Rotman's historical-semiotic question remains productive precisely because it asks how a determinate signifying role is constituted. The essay's source-pole is not dissolved into that role, and the role's actual historical constitution is not dismissed as unreal.

An exact formal neighbour preserves the same discipline. In von Neumann's representation, `1 = {0}` states a membership relation; it does not identify the empty set with native One. The finite self-application `2 + 2² = 4+2` retains the original terms and their four pairings. It has a different operation from ordinal succession. Neither formula discharges Rotman's historical argument. The native eightfold and its inverse parents remain the governing field, rather than a collection of historical examples assembled to validate it.

The dossier **returns-to** [E5’s research boundary](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#research-boundary) through the difference between a historically instituted signifying position and the native subject-condition. Their comparison names the particular relation without treating ordinal succession or an attractive reception story as a substitute for the missing textual witness. This register-3 discipline lets an attribution change while the independently derived operation retains its standing.

## #5→0 — The loan returns with its history available

[M13](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/13-s1-p0-sign-migrates.md) **returns-to** migration through changed permissions. Its receiving practice matters because the same inscription can be recognised while its use changes. [M18](../../../section-rooms/02-return-of-zero/movements/18-s1-p5-loan-returns.md) **returns-to** the philosophical loan: mathematical exactness can enter a wider symbolic relation without being unlearned. The loan does not retrospectively turn every historical zero into the completed integral Symbol, nor make the modern symbolic return an ordinary arithmetic identity.

The [Advent manuscript](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject.md) **grounds** that authorial movement, with [A36](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) retaining the terminal distinction. Source recovery can revise an attribution, a chronology or a claim about reception while leaving the native derivation intact. Conversely, the derivation cannot decide which manuscript contains a line, which edition transcribes it accurately, or what a historical institution prohibited. Each return reaches the office capable of answering it.

E3's [Credere](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) carries the practical consequence. A reader can rely on a selected translation for its stated scope while keeping the next collation open. The [whole investigation-and-faith aphorism](../aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) remains the admitted native027 relation between inquiry and continuation; it provides no exemption from a documentary correction. E4's Trust operation keeps that correction route available when the account is used again.

The dossier's achieved contribution is a differentiated source-facing account: exact arithmetic witnesses, a corrected use of the reception critic, two independently specified Latin-source tasks, and a preserved semiotic disagreement. Its next development can add actual passages to those tasks without rebuilding the whole argument around a received legend. The sign returns carrying both its power to calculate and the history through which that power became shareable.
